title: First coming to New Orleans as a child
summary: Love says he partly lived in New Orleans as a baby and boy, staying with his cousin Henrietta from about age ten until sixteen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Another thing I wanted to ask you is when did you come to New Orleans the first time here, remember?

The first time? Mm-hmm. Oh, I used to partly live down there when I was a kid, you know. My mother, she used to go out with my father like that. She used to sing sometimes. Mm-hmm. We'd have kind of a little show like with the man. And I was a baby. Well, my cousin, she lives up in Grittling now. She used to have me with her all the time, mine and me, you know, babysitter. So she take me from Platt when she lived down there on that canal back there. Take me down there. And I was a baby around there. When I went home, I missed her. I used to, you know how it is when a kid gets used to a nurse. I used to want to see her, you know. So mama brought me down there when I was wearing short pants. I must have been about five or six years old. And I stayed around there. And I'd miss mama and them go to crime. She'd send me back to Plattman, you know. Send me back home. Well, after I got to be a big boy, around 10, 11, and 12, up to about 16 years old, I stayed down there with my cousin, Henrietta. She was living right there on New Nez Street.
